definitions.gloss: synthetic fiber; chemical fiber; man-made fabric
definitions.explanation: Short for {化学繊維|かがくせんい}: fibers made by chemical processes, such as polyester, nylon and rayon, and cloth woven from them. Common on clothing labels and in talk about laundry.

examples.japanese: {化繊|かせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧。
examples.english: A shirt made of synthetic fabric.

examples.japanese: {化繊|かせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾|かわ}き→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧やすい。

{化繊|かせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}き→起きる：00521_okiru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Synthetic clothes build up static electricity in winter, so I choose cotton.

notes:
Clipped from ⟦{化学繊維|かがくせんい}→化学繊維：22749_kagakuseni⟧ (chemical fiber).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{化学繊維|かがくせんい}→化学繊維：22749_kagakuseni⟧: the full form
- ⟦{合成繊維|ごうせいせんい}→合成繊維：22280_gouseiseni⟧: synthetic fiber in the strict sense (polyester, nylon, acrylic), one kind of {化繊|かせん}
- {天然繊維|てんねんせんい}: natural fiber (cotton, wool, silk)

Do not confuse with the homophones ⟦{下線|かせん}→下線：00190_kasen⟧ (underline), ⟦{河川|かせん}→河川：13276_kasen⟧ (rivers) and ⟦{寡占|かせん}→寡占：24627_kasen⟧ (oligopoly).
